title: Battle of Canyon Creek
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Canyon Creek", at revision 1380089328, opens: "The Battle of Canyon Creek was a military engagement in Montana Territory between the Nez Perce Indians and the United States Army's 7th Cavalry. The battle was part of the larger Indian Wars of the latter 19th century and the immediate Nez Perce War. It took place on September 13, 1877, west of present-day Billings in Yellowstone County, in the canyons and benches around Canyon Creek." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4870636, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1877 battle of the Nez-Perce war". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
